ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 16 one-year ram-directional hydrogen ENA maps with Compton-Getting correction applied and no survival-probability correction. The product provides one-year maps covering mission years 2009 through 2019 in Solar West Ecliptic coordinates. MONO denotes the mono-energy Compton-Getting-corrected map representation. The science arrays use a 60 by 30 longitude-latitude grid for IBEX-Hi energy channels 2-6. The channel 2-6 FWHM energy ranges are 0.52-0.95, 0.84-1.55, 1.36-2.50, 1.99-3.75, and 3.13-6.00 keV; the corresponding nominal energies are 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV. The CDF includes a dimensionless fit-parameter map (Parm), differential flux, signal-to-noise ratio, and flux-variance maps, together with virtual _plasma alternate-view variables and Flux*_movie map-movie views. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R16_CG_NOSP_RAM_MONO_1YR.

NumericalData.Caveats: This product is Compton-Getting corrected but has no ENA survival-probability correction; the fluxes therefore have not been scaled from the IBEX observing location at approximately 1 AU to the outer heliosphere. The _plasma variables and Flux*_movie variables are virtual CDAWeb alternate views of the corresponding science arrays. Solar Ecliptic longitude and latitude are the coordinate support variables for the 60 by 30 map grid.
